content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the function `cqspi_setup_flash()` returning success or potentially uninitialized values when it encountered errors while reading the chip select property from the device tree. Specifically, the original code did not properly handle the return value of `of_property_read_u32()`, which could lead to misleading success indications even when an error occurred. The patch corrects this by ensuring that appropriate error codes are returned in case of failure, specifically setting `ret` to `-EINVAL` when the chip select value is out of range.

Root cause:
The bug was caused by the function `cqspi_setup_flash()` returning success or potentially uninitialized values when it encountered errors while reading the chip select property from the device tree. Specifically, the original code did not properly handle the return value of `of_property_read_u32()`, which could lead to misleading success indications even when an error occurred. The patch corrects this by ensuring that appropriate error codes are returned in case of failure, specifically setting `ret` to `-EINVAL` when the chip select value is out of range.
Patch:
From 10ad1d754a434c024ce7eeb1cec9f69fd3ecc863 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Dan Carpenter <dan.carpenter@oracle.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Oct 2016 11:30:39 +0300
Subject: [PATCH] mtd: spi-nor: Fix some error codes in cqspi_setup_flash()

We return success or possibly uninitialized values on these error paths
instead of proper error codes.

Fixes: 140623410536 ("mtd: spi-nor: Add driver for Cadence Quad SPI Flash Controller")
Signed-off-by: Dan Carpenter <dan.carpenter@oracle.com>
Reviewed-by: Marek Vasut <marex@denx.de>
Reviewed-by: Moritz Fischer <moritz.fischer@ettus.com>
Signed-off-by: Cyrille Pitchen <cyrille.pitchen@atmel.com>
---
 drivers/mtd/spi-nor/cadence-quadspi.c | 4 +++-
 1 file changed, 3 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/drivers/mtd/spi-nor/cadence-quadspi.c b/drivers/mtd/spi-nor/cadence-quadspi.c
index 944863be0320..d489fbd07c12 100644
--- a/drivers/mtd/spi-nor/cadence-quadspi.c
+++ b/drivers/mtd/spi-nor/cadence-quadspi.c
@@ -1077,12 +1077,14 @@ static int cqspi_setup_flash(struct cqspi_st *cqspi, struct device_node *np)
 
 	/* Get flash device data */
 	for_each_available_child_of_node(dev->of_node, np) {
-		if (of_property_read_u32(np, "reg", &cs)) {
+		ret = of_property_read_u32(np, "reg", &cs);
+		if (ret) {
 			dev_err(dev, "Couldn't determine chip select.\n");
 			goto err;
 		}
 
 		if (cs >= CQSPI_MAX_CHIPSELECT) {
+			ret = -EINVAL;
 			dev_err(dev, "Chip select %d out of range.\n", cs);
 			goto err;
 		}
